items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: And the other was Amos Woodruff, who had a bad ticker

ctx.x: He said, "I'll tell you what I'm going to do. I'm going to bring your whole outfit in tomorrow and we'll start rehearsing, and we'll start processing you. You'll get passports and things like that." This we did. We came on in. He said, "While you're in town, all you have to do is have everybody call at my office about 12:00 every day. I may want you to go down to the Battery and play for some troops that come in, which would be maybe about an hour's work, and then I want you to go here and do this." And said,…

But we got processed for this trip. Then I found I had two men in the band who couldn't pass the examination. One was Bill Martin. He had a heart murmur. And the other was Amos Woodruff, who had a bad ticker, and he was fat and a little bit overweight. So they sent them back to St. Louis.
